name: Tsumiki Accounting
description: A precise, editorial and minimal theme for a small accounting practice: a cool paper ground, mist bands, ink-navy type and one slate accent for links and the tsumiki marks (three small stacked squares, like wooden blocks, opening every section label); Spectral over Commissioner, fees and dates in tabular figures. The header puts the wordmark top-left and the menu as a numbered list in the corner. The home page is an editorial masthead (dateline row, a large headline, one wide photograph) over a numbered service index with fees (tax returns, bookkeeping, payroll, company set-up), the method, the next tax dates, the four accountants and the journal. The footer is a quiet static street plan beside the office address card. With services, fees, a month-by-month tax calendar, about, contact, newsletter and journal. The office details and the fee schedule are synced patterns, edited once.

fonts.role: headings, the site title, the masthead, service numbers, fees and dates (tabular figures)
fonts.source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/spectral (Light, Regular and Italic, subset to Latin as WOFF2)

fonts.role: body text, labels, navigation, tables, forms and buttons
fonts.source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/commissioner (variable font instanced to static 300, 400 and 500, subset to Latin as WOFF2)
